title: a non-transactional stateful workflow that fails part-way keeps its earlier saves and leaves no instance row
note: The workflow's state row is written with the body's last write on every backend.  .NET and Python tracked a freshly allocated row before the body ran, so the first repository save also wrote it and a failed run left an instance behind (#6103).

apiCaller.//: The workflow command and its instance read — the not-lifted workflow-route class.
